feature: Hide a commander, PR 5: the commander's own page, hidden and not hidden (README section 4, the Page board)
note: HC_SLUG is a commander slug the signed-in account has scored and NOT hidden (on a local-dev scratch branch, any For you row). The rows run in order at each width and leave the commander as they found it: shown, Hide pressed, the next visit served hidden, Unhide pressed. A run that stops between rows 2 and 4 leaves one hidden_commanders row for the account; delete it. The phone frame is drawn tall so the Hide line under the hero is in the photograph.

rows.label: /commanders/[slug], not hidden: the Hide line (phone under the hero, desktop under the build note)
/commanders/[slug], Hide pressed: the note leads, the kicker reads Hidden, the rank clause says not ranked
/commanders/[slug], the next visit: served hidden by the server
/commanders/[slug], Unhide pressed: the Hide line is back and the rank returns with the refresh
